name: Measure Up
summary: A tape measure button whose steel tape runs out as the progress bar, then whips back home when done
about: A photo backup control drawn as a yellow tape measure. Pressing the case squeezes it and clicks the lock, then the hook flicks out and the tape runs across as the progress bar, its scale sliding out of the case while the spool turns and the coil inside thins. Press again to lock the tape (pause) and again to let it run; at 100% the tape whips back into the case, which kicks from the recoil, throws sparks and pops a tick badge.
how: Press the tape case (or Tab to it and press Enter or Space) to start the backup.
Watch the tape run out with the percentage riding above the hook, the stage and the time left.
Press the case again to lock the tape and pause; press once more to carry on.
Press Cancel to reel the tape in slowly, or wait for 100% to see it whip back home with a tick.
